text: Tabitii Alla yamirii jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen nunɗal, nde tottata haqqeeji Alla ɗin e haqqeeji jeyaaɓe ɓen, hara kadi goɗɗo ɓurnaaka e hoore goɗɗo goo ka ñaawoore si wanaa hara ko no jojjiri. Himo yamira moƴƴingol, nde jeyaaɗo on waɗirta ko fawaaki mo kon -wano wintagol- yarlitaare e yaafanagol too- ñuɗo. Himo yamira kadi moƴƴoragol e joomiraɓe ɓadondiral ɓen ko ɓe hatonjinta e mun ko. E senngo goo, Himo haɗa kala ko kaani, wano konngol pankare maa kuuɗe jeeno. Himo haɗa kadi gaay e tooñe, e townitagol e yimɓe ɓen. Himo waajora on ko O yamiri on kon e ko O haɗi on e mun kon e ɗee Aayeeje, belajo'o, on taskoto waajitoron.
